summary: Acumen Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on two items tied to a pipeline wind-down. On November 3, 2026 it noticed voluntary full prepayment of its K2 HealthVentures term loan, paying roughly $23.3 million cash on hand on November 5 covering principal, accrued interest, a $1.6 million final fee and lender expenses; all liens and the lender's conversion right were released. Separately, following its October 30, 2026 announcement to cease sabirnetug development (including the ALTITUDE-AD open-label extension) and evaluate strategic options, the board approved exit/disposal costs. Watch remaining cash runway and strategic-review outcome.
